VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 88 tests pass, satisfying criterion (2). However, criterion (1)—that the race condition is actually fixed—is not demonstrated by the evidence. A passing test suite only proves the bug is fixed if tests specifically exercise the token-refresh race condition; there is no evidence such a test exists, and race conditions are notoriously prone to passing tests intermittently. The self-report claim that "the bug is fixed" is SELF-class and not independently verifiable. Without attestation of a specific regression/concurrency test covering the race, criterion (1) is unproven.
